units.source_text: 花散里收到了源氏公子的信，悲伤之余，也写了长长的回信来，并附有丽景殿女御的信。

en.t: Hanachirusato received Prince Genji's letter, and in her sorrow she also wrote a long reply, enclosing as well a letter from the lady of Reikeiden.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，觉得饶有风趣，并且很是难得。

en.t: When Prince Genji read them, he found them full of charm and thought them very rare and precious.

units.source_text: 他反复阅读二人来信，觉得可慰孤寂，但又觉得增加了别恨。

en.t: He read the two women's letters again and again, feeling that they comforted his loneliness, yet also that they deepened the sorrow of separation.
